import requests
from datetime import datetime

def ejecutar_skill(comando):
    if "mira si hay una nueva versión de Ollama" in comando:
        latest_version = get_latest_ollama_version()
        if latest_version:
            print(f"La última versión de Ollama es {latest_version['tag_name']} publicada el {latest_version['published_at']}.")
            if latest_version['tag_name'] != get_last_checked_version():
                print("¡Nueva versión disponible!")
                print("Cambios principales:")
                for change in latest_version['changes']:
                    print(f"- {change}")
                update_last_checked_version(latest_version['tag_name'])
            else:
                print("No hay nuevas versiones disponibles.")
        else:
            print("No se pudo obtener la información de la versión de Ollama.")
    else:
        print("Comando no reconocido.")

def get_latest_ollama_version():
    url = "https://api.github.com/repos/ollama/ollama/releases/latest"
    response = requests.get(url)
    if response.status_code == 200:
        data = response.json()
        changes = [item['body'] for item in data['body'].split('\n') if item.strip().startswith('*')]
        return {
            "tag_name": data['tag_name'],
            "published_at": datetime.strptime(data['published_at'], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").strftime("%d/%m/%Y"),
            "changes": changes
        }
    return None

def get_last_checked_version():
    try:
        with open("last_checked_version.txt", "r") as file:
            return file.read().strip()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None

def update_last_checked_version(version):
    with open("last_checked_version.txt", "w") as file:
        file.write(version)
